column1: # FRAME NUMBERS ARE VM FRAMES (-3710 from the VM sweep).
# JP shot rows for convert_opening.py, from the 1-frame sweep with eyes-on
# scene identification.  A finer segmentation would fragment the LINEUP
# scroll into single-frame rows; the converter's scroll clustering expects
# the pan inside one shot row (USA precedent: shot 2 lumps GANG BAR + LINEUP).  JP scene order
# differs from USA: LINEUP comes BEFORE GANG BAR, a CAPCOM (R) card plays
# before CODY & GUY, and the opening ends on a white flash into black.
# The map fades in at f3848; 3400-3845 is Sega license/boot material.
